purpose: Teach: まったり/でかけ/ご機嫌/困ら/頑固/恨み/不器用/留守番

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 桜、休日、まったりするのも才能だよ。
lines.en: Sakura, you know—just relaxing on days off? That's a real skill.
lines.style: Conversational, almost musing. Gentle start. Warm tone that lands like a small compliment. Steady, unhurried pacing. The kind of comment that expects nothing in return.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。先輩、今日、でかけずに公園散歩、ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Yeah. Thank you for doing this with me today, senpai—just a walk in the park instead of something bigger.
lines.style: Sincere but modest. Slight hesitation before 'thank you'—she's checking herself for sounding ungrateful. Soft, careful delivery. Eye-contact level steady but not forced.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ご機嫌で歩く犬、見るだけで癒されるよな。
lines.en: Watching dogs who are just… happy like that. It really does settle something in you.
lines.style: Observant, almost to himself. Slow warm pace. He's noticing something small and letting it matter. Breathing is easy. Slight trailing softness at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 家族を困らせない子供、私、なれてないかも。
lines.en: I'm still not very good at being the kind of kid who doesn't put my family through things.
lines.style: Quiet, self-critical undertone. She's speaking something she's thought about a lot. Not seeking reassurance—stating a fact she's frustrated with. Slight tension under the gentleness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 頑固な自分も、認めていい。
lines.en: But being stubborn—that's part of who you are. You're allowed to accept that too.
lines.style: Calm conviction without lecturing. Light anchor on 'stubborn'—not a weakness, a fact. The tone of someone talking to someone he respects. Warm, steady, grounded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 恨みを抱える日もあって、辛いです。
lines.en: Some days I just… hold onto anger. And it hurts.
lines.style: Vulnerable opening. Quiet, almost ashamed. Slow pace. She's trusting him with something difficult. Trailing softness—like she's saying it out loud for the first time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感情表現、不器用でもいい。
lines.en: The way you feel things—even if it's clumsy, even if you can't say it perfectly—that's still real. That's enough.
lines.style: Gentle but certain. Warm tone that wraps around the words without condescending. He's speaking from kindness, not pity. Even pacing, breathing easy, like he means every word.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 明日、母が留守番で、家で勉強します。
lines.en: Tomorrow mom will be around, so I'll stay home and study.
lines.style: Lighter, more settled. Small turn toward normalcy. Soft warmth—a return to something manageable. No defensiveness. Simple, grounded delivery.
